Indel Signature InsDel13

InsDel13

Note

In the 89-type classification, InsDel_C looks somewhat similar to InsDel13 in the prominence of deletions of Ts that are followed by A. However, the 83-type and 476-type classifications show that InsDel13 has deletions of 2 Ts while InsDel_C has deletions of 1 T.

Nevertheless, InsDel13 and InsDel_C were extracted separately in the 89-type classification, possibly because of the insertion of isolated Ts in InsDel13 but not InsDel_C.

(corresponds to 83-type signature C_ID13)
